# Vendored majiang-core

This directory contains `@kobalab/majiang-core` 1.4.1, pinned from
`kobalab/majiang-core` tag `v1.4.1` under the MIT License.

- Unmodified CommonJS sources: `lib/`
- Browser ES module generated by `scripts/build-majiang-core.mjs`: `browser.js`
- Upstream license: `LICENSE`

The vendored package manifest adds `"type": "module"` so Node and browsers load
the generated ES module without ambiguity. The upstream CommonJS files remain
byte-for-byte unchanged and are consumed only by the build script.

Run the build script after updating the pinned upstream sources.
